admission.justification: A future reconsideration refactor could silence a vanished directory without a row or accept a stale refreshed link merely because a judgment row exists. The evaluator and gate must preserve these two distinct recovery boundaries.

applicability: Converted-leaf reconsider_on evaluation of base decisions and current gate judgment of a changed candidate reconsideration anchor.
conditions: Supersession is derived from decisions on both memory sides; base decisions alone supply reconsider_on links to evaluate.

A directory holding a base file and no candidate file fires route_absent without needing a history row. A family route equal to or inside the directory participates in the family-row fallback, including changed rows only when its routes differ.

A different candidate reconsider_on anchor that is not current fires refresh_not_current; ordinary history does not answer it. The current gate requires a current anchor or the exact base target restored, subject to supersession.
exclusions: INV-83YJKE remains the independent narrower supersession guarantee; this record does not replace or revise it.
No transitive reconsideration, prose reconsider_when evaluation, candidate-new decision triggering or claim that an ordinary satisfying row repairs a noncurrent refreshed anchor.
statement: Reconsideration ignores decisions superseded on either memory side, detects route absence and descendant rerouting, and keeps changed stale refresh links open until current or restored.
